verdict.rationale: Mollie is a payments platform/API, not an AI agent or assistant product with a tool-use interface that a user could extend by plugging in external MCP servers. The evidence only shows Mollie shipping its own MCP server (docs.mollie.com/docs/mollie-mcp-server, mcp.mollie.com) for other AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to consume — the reverse role — so the 'consume MCP servers as tools' axis is a category error for this product.
